title: AI Emotional Support: Trust vs Control and Consent
discussion_signal: The post argues that deletion controls can matter more to emotional-support use than technically complex privacy options, because users may not understand the latter.
linked_research_question: Whether trust depends on usable control and exit rights, not only on empathetic behavior or technical privacy claims.
